decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Planning Statement, Local Level Requirements Statement, Heritage Statement, Drawing Numbers MAG-01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 09, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, Photo Montage, received 22/12/10. Drawing Numbers MAG-E2C, MAG02D received 08/03/11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 5 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Further details of all internal plumbing, drainage, pipework and any works to the service conduit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of ground floor extension to the west and rear of the property. Replacement of 1960s sliding doors at third floor level. Replacement of two windows to rear in 1960s extension. Minor relocation of external drainage/vent pipes on west facade. Internal refurbishment including minor structural works.
